name: Inland Center Mall
description: Inland Center Mall is an enclosed regional shopping center serving San Bernardino and the greater Inland Empire with a mix of national retailers, dining options, and entertainment venues. The mall provides a convenient shopping destination for families and value-conscious consumers in the area. With anchor stores and a diverse tenant mix, it serves as a community gathering place for the local population.
demographics: Inland Center Mall serves a diverse, value-conscious demographic in San Bernardino with a primary trade area drawing middle-income families and younger shoppers aged 25-45. The center attracts residents from San Bernardino and surrounding Inland Empire communities, with household incomes ranging from $40,000-$75,000, including a significant Hispanic population and multi-generational households. Shoppers typically seek affordable fashion, family dining, and entertainment options, with strong weekend traffic from families looking for convenient one-stop shopping experiences.
summary: A regional enclosed mall serving San Bernardino's Inland Empire with diverse retail, dining, and entertainment for value-conscious families.
